You aren’t ordering anything again? Melissa: I’m dieting. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open Lady Annalie: Oi, Oi…{{wi}} Come on now. This is a cafe. A bunch of water, coffee beans and maybe a little cream won’t make you gain weight. Melissa: I don’t want my teeth to change color. Lady Annalie: You just changed your excuse, now did you? Lady Annalie: Now that I think about it, you said something similar back at the karaoke when you refused a slushie! #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.shock Lady Annalie: I’m not as stupid as you think, you know. Melissa: The surgery is planned for later this year. The plan is to enhance my assets to an H cup. Lady Annalie: H cup! {{punch}} Really?! T-That’s too big! You: Annalie, please stop screaming about breasts. People are looking at us… #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open Lady Annalie: Alright, Mr. Tough Guy, I don’t know if you are aware, but an H cup is a pretty big deal. Lady Annalie: You should be the one to freak out the most. Where is your pride as a man? You: Oh, well. Maybe I’m not freaking out because it was obviously a joke? #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Lady Annalie: W-What? Really? Noo~ I’m legit gonna cry~ Lady Annalie: I always wanted a friend with big breasts~ Lady Annalie: Why did you make a lie like that, Melissa?~ Melissa: … Melissa: Is it really a lie when parents tell their children Santa is real, when all they want is for them to keep dreaming and stay happy by indulging in the fantasy? #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: … After some drinks and a few hours more of talking, we decided to go back home. Throughout the whole meetup, Melissa seemed to behave completely fine. I don’t know exactly what changed, but it seemed like she really enjoyed the time we spent together. It’s a good sign that even though she’s dealing with all these regrets, she can still appreciate things like that. But there is one thing that still is on my mind… What the hell is her owner doing? She found herself in a really bad situation and received zero help. Maybe she doesn’t have an owner at all? At some point I should ask her about it, but for now I will leave her be so that she can de-stress a little.
